articles.title: 18 years in, what has Bitcoin truly done?
articles.description: The Bitcoin white paper achieved a lot of what Satoshi Nakamoto set out to accomplish, but the cultural impact it had may outweigh Bitcoin itself, writes CoinDesk's Nikhilesh De.

articles.title: A Nasdaq-listed company may sell $450 million bitcoin, citing Binance hack and quantum fears
articles.description: Next Technology Holding cited exchange security and quantum computing risks in authorizing sales or loans against its 5,833 BTC. It says none of the coins are held at Binance.

articles.title: Berkshire ekes out some new highs, but October rally stalls
articles.description: Berkshire Hathaway shares managed to set a few more all-time highs in an otherwise lackluster week of trading.

articles.title: Qatari mediators held talks in Tehran aimed at restarting direct U.S.-Iran negotiations, source says
articles.description: Axios reported that Qatari mediators held more than 12 hours of talks in Tehran on Friday to reach a deal to avoid a resumption of American-led attacks on Iran.

articles.title: ‘Pop-up’ super PACs pour $637 million into 2026 midterm races
articles.description: Twenty-two late-forming super PACs spent about $637 million in 2026 congressional races, sometimes before voters could see their donors.

articles.title: Automakers like Rivian and Ford are ‘democratizing 3D printing’ to reduce costs and increase speed
articles.description: Automakers including Ford, Rivian and GM are expanding 3D printing to make prototypes, factory tools and low-volume parts faster and at lower cost.

articles.title: The $6.3 billion Binance hack paradox: Centralization made the hack possible, but also saved $3 billion
articles.description: The Binance hack has revived debates about whether decentralization is the digital asset industry’s greatest security advantage or its biggest point of weakness.

articles.title: Blockchain investigator Chainalysis hit by cybersecurity incident
articles.description: Chainalysis has engaged world-class third-party experts to support a review of its security and strengthen its defenses.

articles.title: Anthropic's path to the Nasdaq just got a lot bumpier
articles.description: Concerning projections from hyperscalers this week punished tech stocks and pushed the Nasdaq to its first three-week losing streak since March.

articles.title: The rise of the 15-foot skeleton—how a viral novelty became a Halloween staple

articles.title: Binance $6.3B record hack sparks pre-election political clashes
articles.description: Some political and administration figures tried to make hay of the biggest-ever crypto heist.

articles.title: Trump called out Big Oil profits. Here’s how much their refining earnings have surged since
articles.description: Trump criticized Big Oil for making “too much money,” but oil majors have since reported surging refining earnings as fuel supplies tightened.

articles.title: AI is coming to construction sites. But does it make workers safer?
articles.description: AI is flagging hazards on construction sites, but researchers say evidence that the technology prevents injuries remains limited.

articles.title: Bitcoin stolen from Binance tops Tesla’s holdings and is over twice El Salvador’s reserve
articles.description: The 18,270 BTC haul is worth about $1.4 billion and comes within 442 coins of SpaceX’s disclosed holdings. Blockchain investigators link the attack to North Korea.

articles.title: OpenAI reportedly cuts fundraising and valuation targets amid AI jitters
articles.description: Anxiety about the AI boom has sent the Nasdaq 100 slumping by about 10% in just three weeks since hitting a record high on October 6, including a 4.5% drop on Friday.

articles.title: Alaska Senate election: DOJ wants to 'segregate' all ballots for 2nd Sullivan candidate
articles.description: The winner of the Alaska election could determine whether Republicans retain their majority in the U.S. Senate or if Democrats take control of the chamber.

articles.title: Jim Cramer says it's time to look beyond tech. Here are 4 consumer stocks he likes
articles.description: Cramer said investors looking to diversify beyond the struggling AI trade should consider consumer staples.

articles.title: Meta outlook revised downward by S&P on cash flow and capex concerns
articles.description: Meta has been given a negative outlook by S&P Global Ratings due to the company's hefty capital expenditures and concerns about free cash flow.

articles.title: Cramer’s week ahead: Expect more volatility as tech earnings, midterms loom
articles.description: Investors await earnings from Apple, AMD, and other major companies, as well as the midterm elections and the monthly jobs report.

articles.title: Gamble on democracy: Inside suspicious election-contracts trading on prediction markets
articles.description: CNBC examines unusual price spikes in election prediction markets and how low-volume contracts can be moved by relatively small trades.
